Problem Statement:
Write a program to give the following output for the given string S of size N.(character containing even number of occurences should be elaborated else print the same format)
Eg 1: Input: a1b10
Output: a1bbbbbbbbbb
Eg: 2: Input: b3c6d15
Output: b3ccccccd15 
Input Description:
Input Size : 1 <= N <= 100000 
Sample Input:
a1b10 
Sample Output:
a1bbbbbbbbbb
